build_p100_meaning.meaning: 建筑(Building, train_id=1) bias 从 -0.0384 改为 +0.10 的校准提交

calibration_formula: logits += bias_tensor  (逐通道加法, bias_tensor shape (1,8,1,1))
scale: not applied when --prior-bias given (prior_scale=3.0 only used in PRIOR_LOG_BIAS default branch)
pipeline: STEP1: 每视图forward得logits(1,8,1024,1024或需上采样)
STEP4: logits = accum / n_views (8视图平均, D4=4rot×2mirror)
STEP5: logits = logits + bias_tensor (8维校准, 唯一一次应用)
tta_type: rot_tta.py D4 (4旋转 x 2水平镜像 = 8视图)
evidence_note: 所有值来自实际运行文件(脚本/run_config/zip sha)，非聊天记录或注释推断。conflict_resolved: 最终8维向量=建筑+0.10版[-0.2,+0.10,0.0709,0.7,3.6,0.4,3.3215,-0.5]; 之前出现-0.0384是6维锁定版(建筑未动时的向量), build_p100将建筑从-0.0384提到+0.10
